analysis: POST-HOC fixed competing predictions for E77 free off-diagonals

design.registration_timing: After the first E77 profile and full launch; before reading full E77 off-diagonal outcomes for this analysis.
design.source: Per-model/per-world/per-trait E75 retrieval_baseline three-seed diagonal five-category frequencies only.

predictors.current_exec_trait: Use the old diagonal distribution of the current execution trait.
predictors.dialogue_source_trait: Use the old diagonal distribution of the donor conversation trait.
predictors.equal_mixture: Arithmetic mean of those two old diagonal distributions, weights fixed at 0.5/0.5.

design.scored_data: Only the two E77 free off-diagonals: donor != exec trait, all three original seeds.
design.primary_explanatory_subset: All dataset rows except the first row used in the E77 profile; exclusion depends only on source order.
design.additional_descriptive_subset: All 102 source graphs, including the profile graph.

loss.brier: sum over five categories of (p_k - indicator_k)^2, range 0..2, lower is better
loss.log_loss: -log(p_observed) using natural logarithm, lower is better

design.aggregation: Average the two off-diagonals and three seeds within source graph, then average graphs.
design.uncertainty: 4000 paired source-graph bootstrap samples, percentile 95% pointwise intervals, seed 770075.
design.interpretation: Prediction of new C x current-trait combinations on already seen worlds; not new-world generalization, neural modularity, or independent replication.
design.no_tuning: No optimization, fitted mixture weights, selected seeds, outcome-based exclusion, or E77 parameter fitting.

profile_exclusion_rule: First original data row, fixed before reading full E77 outcomes for this analysis.
scope: Added after E77 initial profile; not an original preregistered primary endpoint or independent experiment.
Same source worlds and seeds; predictions address new intervention combinations, not new-world generalization.
Pure exec/C predictors are deliberately restrictive descriptive alternatives; winning either does not identify a brain module or exclusive causal mechanism.
Equal mixture has no optimized weight; alpha=0.5 fixed uniformly for all five categories.
Physical consumption secondary is reused from the review report; exact bound-goal main endpoint remains unchanged elsewhere.
Three source seeds produce noisy predictive distributions; score differences remain paired and pointwise, not an automatic scientific decision rule.
